# Strategy Parameters

[](https://github.com/aydh5848-design/futures-1-mnq-backtest-scaffold/blob/arati/Downloads/futures-1-mnq-backtest-scaffold/STRATEGY_SUMMARY.md#strategy-parameters)

|Parameter|Value|
|:-|:-|
|Instrument|MNQ (Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100)|
|Timeframe|1-minute bars|
|HTF liquidity window|20 minutes|
|MSS swing lookback|5 bars|
|Stop loss|8 × ATR|
|Risk:Reward|0.75 (targets \~61% WR)|
|Risk per trade|1.50% of equity|
|Max contracts|7|
|Session (entries only)|09:30 – 15:45 ET|
|EOD close|OFF — hold to TP/SL|

# Trend Filters (Asymmetric)

[](https://github.com/aydh5848-design/futures-1-mnq-backtest-scaffold/blob/arati/Downloads/futures-1-mnq-backtest-scaffold/STRATEGY_SUMMARY.md#trend-filters-asymmetric)

|Direction|Filter|
|:-|:-|
|Long|EMA-100 sloping up over last 20 bars|
|Short|EMA-500 sloping down over last 100 bars AND price below EMA-500|

Applied at **sweep detection** — if the trend gate fails, the sweep is ignored entirely.

# Contract Ladder

[](https://github.com/aydh5848-design/futures-1-mnq-backtest-scaffold/blob/arati/Downloads/futures-1-mnq-backtest-scaffold/STRATEGY_SUMMARY.md#contract-ladder)

Position sizing formula per trade:

    contracts = min(MAX, max(floor, int(equity × 1.5% / (stop_distance × $2))))
    

|Equity|Min contracts|
|:-|:-|
|< $10,000|2|
|$10,000 – $14,999|3|
|$15,000 – $34,999|4|
|$35,000 – $54,999|5|
|$55,000 – $84,999|6|
|≥ $85,000|7|

The floor scales up as the account grows. Each trade uses **whole contracts only** — no fractional sizing.

# Cost Assumptions

[](https://github.com/aydh5848-design/futures-1-mnq-backtest-scaffold/blob/arati/Downloads/futures-1-mnq-backtest-scaffold/STRATEGY_SUMMARY.md#cost-assumptions)

|Cost|Value|
|:-|:-|
|Commission|$0.62 per contract per side|
|Slippage|1 tick (0.25 pts) against fill direction|
|Point value|$2.00 per index point|

All results above are **after** commission and slippage.

# Key Design Decisions

[](https://github.com/aydh5848-design/futures-1-mnq-backtest-scaffold/blob/arati/Downloads/futures-1-mnq-backtest-scaffold/STRATEGY_SUMMARY.md#key-design-decisions)

* **Wide SL (8×ATR) is load-bearing.** Tightening it collapses the win rate. The strategy depends on giving trades room to breathe before the reversal completes.
* **No EOD close.** Force-flattening positions at 15:45 was the primary killer of the strategy — it cut winners before they reached TP. Positions now run overnight to their TP or SL.
* **RR=0.75 targets high win rate.** A tighter target (closer than the entry) means more trades close at profit before SL is hit, producing the 61% WR.
* **Equity ladder prevents early blowup.** Starting with 4 contracts on a $5k account would risk \~50%+ per losing streak. The 2-contract floor below $10k protects the early compounding phase.

Once I have at least a month of live paper-trading results and complete additional internal testing, I’ll consider making the strategy and supporting files available for others to review.
